scenario: Node.js API deployed to staging and production with tests, image scanning, gated production, and concurrency controls.
pipeline:
name: Node API CI/CD

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: node-api-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: example/node-api

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test -- --coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: coverage/

  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
      - uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.24.0
        with:
          image-ref: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          exit-code: '1'

  deploy-staging:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
      - run: kubectl set image deployment/node-api api=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} -n staging
      - run: kubectl rollout status deployment/node-api -n staging --timeout=180s

  deploy-production:
    needs: deploy-staging
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
      - run: kubectl set image deployment/node-api api=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }} -n production
      - run: kubectl rollout status deployment/node-api -n production --timeout=300s

scenario: Python service pipeline with linting and unit tests but no deployment, security scan, or pinned runtime image.
pipeline:
name: Python CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: pytest tests/ --junitxml=reports/junit.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: reports/

scenario: Rails application using test services, cached dependencies, SAST/container scans, review apps, and protected production deployment.
pipeline:
stages:
  - prepare
  - test
  - security
  - package
  - deploy

variables:
  BUNDLE_PATH: vendor/bundle
  DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: ""

cache:
  key:
    files:
      - Gemfile.lock
  paths:
    - vendor/bundle

bundle:
  stage: prepare
  image: ruby:3.3
  script:
    - bundle config set path vendor/bundle
    - bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - vendor/bundle
    expire_in: 1 week

rspec:
  stage: test
  image: ruby:3.3
  services:
    - postgres:16
    - redis:7
  variables:
    DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres/app_test
    REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
  script:
    - bundle exec rails db:schema:load
    - bundle exec rspec --format RspecJunitFormatter --out rspec.xml
  artifacts:
    when: always
    reports:
      junit: rspec.xml

brakeman:
  stage: security
  image: ruby:3.3
  script:
    - bundle exec brakeman --no-pager --exit-on-warn

container_scan:
  stage: security
  image: docker:27
  services: [docker:27-dind]
  script:
    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .
    - trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA

build_image:
  stage: package
  image: docker:27
  services: [docker:27-dind]
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
  script:
    - docker login -u $CI_REGISTRY_USER -p $CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD $CI_REGISTRY
    - docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA .
    - docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA

deploy_review:
  stage: deploy
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.review.example.com
    on_stop: stop_review
  rules:
    - if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_ID
  script:
    - helm upgrade --install app charts/app --namespace review --set image.tag=$CI_COMMIT_SHA

production:
  stage: deploy
  environment:
    name: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: manual
  script:
    - helm upgrade --install app charts/app --namespace production --set image.tag=$CI_COMMIT_SHA --atomic

scenario: Legacy Jenkinsfile deploying from main with weak secret handling, minimal tests, mutable tags, and direct SSH rollout.
Mobile app workflow with dependency caching, test fanout, signing through contexts, and manual release approval.
pipeline:
version: 2.1

orbs:
  android: circleci/android@2.5.0

executors:
  android-executor:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/android:2024.11

jobs:
  unit_tests:
    executor: android-executor
    steps:
      - checkout
      - restore_cache:
          keys:
            - gradle-v1-{{ checksum "gradle.lockfile" }}
      - run: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug
      - save_cache:
          key: gradle-v1-{{ checksum "gradle.lockfile" }}
          paths:
            - ~/.gradle/caches
      - store_test_results:
          path: app/build/test-results

  build_internal:
    executor: android-executor
    steps:
      - checkout
      - run: ./gradlew assembleRelease
      - persist_to_workspace:
          root: app/build/outputs/apk/release
          paths:
            - app-release.apk

  deploy_internal:
    executor: android-executor
    steps:
      - attach_workspace:
          at: /tmp/apk
      - run: bundle exec fastlane internal

workflows:
  build_test_release:
    jobs:
      - unit_tests
      - build_internal:
          requires:
            - unit_tests
      - hold_release:
          type: approval
          requires:
            - build_internal
          filters:
            branches:
              only: main
      - deploy_internal:
          context: mobile-release
          requires:
            - hold_release

scenario: .NET service with build/test, code coverage, infrastructure validation, staged deployment, and production approvals via environment.
pipeline:
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  buildConfiguration: Release

stages:
  - stage: BuildAndTest
    jobs:
      - job: test
        pool:
          vmImage: ubuntu-24.04
        timeoutInMinutes: 20
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            inputs:
              packageType: sdk
              version: 9.0.x
          - script: dotnet restore
          - script: dotnet build --configuration $(buildConfiguration) --no-restore
          - script: dotnet test --configuration $(buildConfiguration) --no-build --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --logger trx
          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            condition: succeededOrFailed()
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: VSTest
              testResultsFiles: '**/*.trx'
          - task: PublishCodeCoverageResults@2
            inputs:
              summaryFileLocation: '$(Agent.TempDirectory)/**/coverage.cobertura.xml'

  - stage: ValidateInfrastructure
    dependsOn: BuildAndTest
    jobs:
      - job: terraform
        pool:
          vmImage: ubuntu-24.04
        steps:
          - script: terraform fmt -check
          - script: terraform init -backend=false
          - script: terraform validate
          - script: checkov -d infra --quiet

  - stage: DeployStaging
    dependsOn: ValidateInfrastructure
    jobs:
      - deployment: staging
        environment: staging
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - script: ./scripts/deploy.sh staging $(Build.SourceVersion)

  - stage: DeployProduction
    dependsOn: DeployStaging
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
    jobs:
      - deployment: production
        environment: production
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - script: ./scripts/deploy.sh production $(Build.SourceVersion)

scenario: Monorepo pipeline using path filters, matrix tests, dependency caching, and service-specific deploys, but no explicit security stage.
pipeline:
name: Monorepo CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  deployments: write

jobs:
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      api: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.api }}
      web: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.web }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            api:
              - 'services/api/**'
            web:
              - 'apps/web/**'

  test:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        package: [services/api, apps/web]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm --dir ${{ matrix.package }} test
      - run: pnpm --dir ${{ matrix.package }} build

  deploy-api:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.changes.outputs.api == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production-api
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy-api.sh ${{ github.sha }}

  deploy-web:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.changes.outputs.web == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production-web
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy-web.sh ${{ github.sha }}

scenario: Small team Bitbucket pipeline with tests and deployment branches, but limited hardening and no artifact or security reporting.
pipeline:
image: node:22

pipelines:
  pull-requests:
    '**':
      - step:
          name: Test
          caches:
            - node
          script:
            - npm ci
            - npm test
            - npm run build
  branches:
    main:
      - step:
          name: Build
          caches:
            - node
          script:
            - npm ci
            - npm run build
      - step:
          name: Deploy production
          deployment: production
          script:
            - pipe: atlassian/scp-deploy:1.5.0
              variables:
                USER: $DEPLOY_USER
                SERVER: $DEPLOY_HOST
                REMOTE_PATH: /var/www/app
                LOCAL_PATH: dist
